description: Cyber-Physical Power System Dataset for Cyber Security of Digital Substations is a data set deposited in Zenodo by its authors Nicola Cibin, Nadine Kabbara (Delft University of Technology). This cyber-physical dataset was generated by simulating various power system operating conditions and cyber attacks on an IEC 61850-compliant testbed. The testbed includes a Real-Time Digital Simulator (RTDS) and both physical and virtual Intelligent Electronic Devices (IEDs) in a hardware-in-the-loop configuration. Coverage: not stated; the metadata date the deposit to 2025. The formats are not stated in the metadata. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked, and the coverage and resolution are those of the abstract only. It can support power-system, energy-planning and grid-operation studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-zenodo-repository.
